milestones.outcome: The first-party Git metadata readers refuse unreadable repository formats with a named reason and match Git's config syntax, ignore-case folding, POSIX classes, index trailer and extension rules and HEAD resolution, each shown by a real-Git contract test that fails on the base readers.
exit_criteria: Fixes 1-7 pass their real-Git workspace contract tests on macOS, each shown failing on the readers at RFC base 9a4f61976; a reftable checkout is refused under the owner's Q2 answer (a) of 2026-10-13.
Core unit tests, the core-only preset, both architecture-boundary checks, format, changed-line tidy and the documentation gate pass.
milestones.boundary: Q2 was answered (a) on 2026-10-13; reading reftable stays with C3. Windows and Linux runs belong to their station cards.

milestones.outcome: The differential harness compares the fixed readers with an isolated Git oracle over the whole corpus on macOS, with the canary course, fuzz oracles, adversarial timing and the 250,000-entry bench recorded for K.
exit_criteria: Agreement per component and case is reported, missing Git features are skipped with the version found, every K divergence is classified, and a one-fix-reverted negative control turns the harness red.
Containment, no-execution and no-write results for K on macOS, fuzz targets with oracles, H6 timings and the scale-bench medians and peak memory are recorded.
milestones.boundary: macOS only; no candidate library is acquired.

milestones.outcome: libgit2 is evaluated per component through the same harness and canary course behind an evaluation-only option, and V and G have desk checks and cost records, on macOS.
exit_criteria: With the option off nothing new is acquired or linked; with it on the pinned archive is verified and every L divergence and canary result is classified per component.
Cost records for L, V and G are committed with measured macOS deltas and no unmeasured platform claim.
milestones.boundary: The shipping configuration and packages are unchanged. Adopting L would wait for Q3; vendoring into core would wait for the owner's approval.

milestones.outcome: A native Windows station runs the contract tests, harness, canary course and libgit2 cost measurements.
exit_criteria: Windows results for H2 and H5 and the Windows cost deltas are recorded in the decision record.

milestones.outcome: A native Linux station runs the contract tests, harness, canary course and libgit2 cost measurements.
exit_criteria: Linux results for H2 and H5 and the Linux cost deltas are recorded in the decision record.

milestones.outcome: Each component C1-C6 has a verdict under the decision rules in a committed decision record, with pending verdicts tied to the evidence or owner answer they wait for.
exit_criteria: The decision record names each verdict, the gate or rule, the evidence links and every question answer it relies on; architecture docs move only if a component moves.
milestones.boundary: Verdicts that need Windows, Linux or an open owner answer stay pending.

milestones.outcome: A reftable checkout is handled as the owner decides under Q2.
exit_criteria: A reftable checkout yields Git's HEAD commit or the chosen refusal or marker, never an empty HeadCommit, shown by a real-Git contract test.
milestones.boundary: The owner answered Q2 (a) on 2026-10-13: refuse now; whether to read reftable is C3's verdict in the decision record.

milestones.outcome: RFC-BPR-0083 is verified against its baseline and closed.
exit_criteria: AC01-AC07 pass with their evidence, the RFC and index agree, and the documentation gate passes.
milestones.boundary: No required native or owner criterion is inferred.
